Card Q&A.a: No, moving a Digimon between areas is different from playing it, so you can't draw a card.
Card Q&A.q: During my breeding phase, I move a level 3 Digimon from my breeding area to my battle area. Can I draw a card off this card's effect?

Effect: [Your Turn] When you play a level 3 yellow Digimon, if this Digimon is suspended, trigger ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck).
